content.short: Cardano NFT based Spaceship round-based game
content.description: Shipy Space is a round based online game where players fight each other to gain fame and earn materials to craft new items for the game. Materials and in game items will be tradeable on the Blockchain. We also plan to have some offline or idle farming features in the game, for those players who don't have as much time to actively play but still want a slice of the play to earn rewards.
